vocabulary.meaning_en: the area around your home
vocabulary.note_ar: حرفا gh صامتان. في بريطانيا تُكتب neighbourhood.
vocabulary.note_en: The gh is silent. UK spelling: neighbourhood.
vocabulary.example: There is a nice park in my neighborhood.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short trip to do a small job, like buying something
vocabulary.example: I do my errands on Saturday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you can borrow books
vocabulary.note_ar: المكتبة التي تبيع الكتب اسمها bookstore.
vocabulary.note_en: A shop that sells books is a bookstore.
vocabulary.example: I borrow books from the library.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give or bring something back
vocabulary.example: Please return the book on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the place where two streets meet
vocabulary.example: The shop is on the corner.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a written message you send by mail
vocabulary.note_ar: تعني أيضًا: حرف من حروف الهجاء.
vocabulary.note_en: It also means a letter of the alphabet (A, B, C).
vocabulary.example: I write a letter to my grandmother.

vocabulary.meaning_en: parents, children, brothers, sisters and other relatives
vocabulary.example: My family lives far from here.

vocabulary.meaning_en: in the place you come from
vocabulary.example: My friends back home call me every week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place where you send letters and buy stamps
vocabulary.example: The post office opens at 9 a.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long way from
vocabulary.example: The airport is far from the city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a box on the street where you put letters to send
vocabulary.example: Put the letter in the mailbox.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small paper you put on a letter to pay for sending it
vocabulary.example: I need two stamps for these letters.

vocabulary.meaning_en: money in coins and paper notes
vocabulary.note_ar: اسم غير معدود: لا نقول a cash.
vocabulary.note_en: Uncountable: say some cash, not a cash.
vocabulary.example: Do you have cash or a card?

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place that keeps and gives money
vocabulary.example: There is a bank behind the school.

vocabulary.meaning_en: at the back of
vocabulary.example: The car is behind the house.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop
vocabulary.note_ar: store أمريكية، و shop بريطانية أكثر.
vocabulary.note_en: store is American; shop is common in the UK.
vocabulary.example: That store sells fruit.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give something for money
vocabulary.example: The store sells stamps.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get something by paying money
vocabulary.example: I need to buy bread.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to require something; it is necessary for you
vocabulary.note_ar: need to + فعل = يحتاج أن يفعل.
vocabulary.example: I need to go to the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: quick
vocabulary.example: Wow, you're fast!

vocabulary.meaning_en: a sweet, cold, frozen food
vocabulary.example: Let's get ice cream after lunch.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a shop where people get their hair cut
vocabulary.example: The hair salon is next to the bank.

vocabulary.meaning_en: all things
vocabulary.note_en: Use a singular verb: everything is.
vocabulary.example: Everything is near my home.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to stay in a place until something happens
vocabulary.example: Wait here. I'll be back.

fine_lines.title: library vs bookstore
fine_lines.explanation_ar: library مكان تستعير منه الكتب وتعيدها مجانًا. bookstore متجر تشتري منه الكتب.
fine_lines.explanation_en: At a library you borrow books and return them. At a bookstore you buy books.

examples.sentence: I return my books to the library.
I buy a new dictionary at the bookstore.

fine_lines.title: these vs those
fine_lines.explanation_ar: these للأشياء الجمع القريبة منك (هذه/هؤلاء)، those للأشياء الجمع البعيدة (تلك/أولئك). المفرد: this و that.
fine_lines.explanation_en: These = plural things near you. Those = plural things far from you. Singular: this and that.

examples.sentence: These are letters to my family.
What are those on the shelf over there?

fine_lines.title: near vs far from
fine_lines.explanation_ar: near = قريب من، far from = بعيد عن.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Near = close to. Far from = a long way from.

examples.sentence: The library is near our apartment.
The post office is far from here.

expressions.meaning_en: Asking for the place of the library.
expressions.example: Excuse me, where is the library?

expressions.phrase: It is on this street on the corner.
expressions.meaning_ar: إنها في هذا الشارع على الناصية.
expressions.meaning_en: It is on this street where it meets another street.
expressions.example: The bank? It is on this street on the corner.

expressions.phrase: Is there a post office near here?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يوجد مكتب بريد قريب من هنا؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking if a post office is close.
expressions.example: Is there a bank near here?

expressions.phrase: There is a bank behind you.
expressions.meaning_en: A bank is at your back.
expressions.example: Look! There is a bank behind you.

expressions.meaning_en: Do you have money in coins and notes?
expressions.example: The shop doesn't take cards. Do you have cash?

expressions.phrase: You know our neighborhood so well.
expressions.meaning_en: You know this area very well.
expressions.example: Thanks! You know our neighborhood so well.

expressions.meaning_en: Stay here for a short time.
expressions.example: Wait here. I'll be back in a minute.
You finished already? Wow, you're fast.

expressions.phrase: I can do all my errands.
expressions.meaning_en: I can do all my small jobs and shopping.
expressions.example: In my neighborhood I can do all my errands on foot.

expressions.meaning_en: All the places we need are close to our home.
expressions.example: I love it here. Everything is near our apartment!

grammar.title: There is / There are
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) نستخدم There is مع المفرد لنقول إن شيئًا موجودًا: There is a bank.
٢) نستخدم There are مع الجمع: There are three coffee shops.
٣) للسؤال نقدّم is/are: Is there a post office near here?
٤) الإجابة: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) There is + singular, to say something exists: There is a bank.
2) There are + plural: There are three coffee shops.
3) Question: Is there a post office near here?
4) Answer: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't.
examples: There is a mailbox across from the store.
There are two parks in my neighborhood.
Is there a library near here? Yes, there is.

grammar.title: can for ability and possibility
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) can + الفعل الأساسي (بدون to) = يستطيع.
٢) لا يتغير can مع he/she: She can buy stamps.
٣) النفي: cannot أو can't.
٤) السؤال: Can I return the books here?
grammar.explanation_en:
1) can + base verb (no to) = be able to.
2) can does not change with he/she: She can buy stamps.
3) Negative: cannot / can't.
4) Question: Can I return the books here?
examples: I can return the books here.
Now I have cash. I can buy stamps.
You can't buy stamps at the library.

grammar.title: need to + verb
grammar.explanation_ar:
١) need to + فعل = يجب/يحتاج أن يفعل.
٢) مع he/she نضيف s: She needs to go.
٣) need + اسم = يحتاج شيئًا: I need stamps.
grammar.explanation_en:
1) need to + verb = it is necessary to do it.
2) With he/she add s: She needs to go.
3) need + noun: I need stamps.
examples: I need to return three books.

questions.question: Where can you borrow books?
questions.explanation_en: You borrow books at a library.

questions.question: ___ a bank behind you.
questions.explanation_en: Use There is with a singular noun.

questions.question: ___ three coffee shops on this street.
questions.explanation_en: Use There are with a plural noun.

questions.question: What do you put on a letter before you send it?
questions.explanation_en: You put a stamp on a letter.

questions.question: "Is there a post office near here?" "No, ___."
questions.explanation_en: The answer is: No, there isn't.

questions.question: "___ are letters to my family." (in my hand)
questions.explanation_en: These is for plural things near you.

questions.question: What is an errand?
choices: a short trip to do a small job
questions.explanation_en: An errand is a short trip to do a small job, like buying something.

questions.question: The post office is not near. It is ___ here.
questions.explanation_en: Far from means a long way from.

questions.question: She ___ to go to the bank.
